Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
This is a challenge for programmers, whose result may interest a lot of players:

Given a collection of cards and the decks from the Tournament Winning Deck Archives, write a program that uses the most cards in your collection to build decks!
A tolerance of 10% of missing cards per deck is acceptable, but the program must minimize the number of missing cards anyway.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
Recent update to  VDB brought this feature, thanks for great proposal.

To use it you must create account, fill inventory with some cards (well with MANY cards if you expect to find any TWD matching it) and turn on Inventory-Mode (it will unlock additional forms in TWD not visible without account/inventory).

Any feedback welcome.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I activated it in the TWD tab, but how do I get decks that match? I clicked on "50 new", but the first deck proposed has almost no cards matching my inventory...

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Ah, got it! One has to select 90% in the "In Inventory by Crypt" and "In Inventory by Library" drop down lists.

Is it on a deck-by-deck basis, or does it select as many decks as possible that can be built (with no copies of a card used by more than one deck of course!)? The latter is a must-have.

I am asking because it proposes 4 Dementation bleed with more copies of Kindred Spirit than are available in my inventory.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
It goes deck-by-deck and together with other filters.

As I understand now, it is not exactly what you requested - it does not aim to build as many decks without reusing cards, but may still be useful for somebody.
